claims: Lyon is located at the confluence of the Rhône and Saône rivers
Lyon is in southeastern France
Lyon is a UNESCO World Heritage city
Lyon is the second-largest metropolitan area
Lyon features 2,000 years of history
Lyon has Roman ruins
Vieux Lyon has Renaissance architecture
Lyon has over 5,300 restaurants
Lyon has traditional bouchons
Lyon has Michelin-starred establishments
Vieux Lyon has hidden passageways called traboules
Fourvière Hill is home to Roman theaters
Fourvière Hill is home to the Basilica Notre-Dame de Fourvière
Presqu'île is the city center between the rivers
Presqu'île features 19th-century buildings
Lyon is home to the Lumière brothers
The Lumière brothers are associated with cinema history
Lyon has the Musée des Confluences
Lyon has Croix-Rousse street art
Lyon is accessible via high-speed train (TGV)
Lyon is located approximately two hours from Paris
